title: Flix Consumer Projection Map Schema
description: Maps a consumer parser's native node vocabulary onto the canonical TreeKind names in ast/treekind.json. Consumers whose parse trees already carry canonical names need no map.

consumer.description: Repository or tool this map belongs to, e.g. tree-sitter-flix.

mappings.description: Native node name -> canonical TreeKind name. Every value must exist in ast/treekind.json.

ignored.description: Native nodes deliberately not mapped -- purely syntactic wrappers, punctuation containers, or nodes with no counterpart in the reference tree. Listing a node here asserts the omission is intentional; anything neither mapped nor ignored is reported as unmapped, which is a gap rather than a decision.

notes.description: Free-form per-node rationale, keyed by native node name.

elide.description: Canonical TreeKind names this consumer legitimately does not produce, skipped when matching. Only a node with exactly one child may be elided -- eliding a branching node would discard structure rather than a wrapper. At the current pin 412 of 3572 canonical nodes (11.5%) are single-child wrappers, Type.Type alone accounting for 247, so a parser that was not the reference's parent will not reproduce them. This is the projection layer, not a rename table.
